overview: The Medford Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board reviewed a presentation on racial disparities in local mortgage lending and received updates on Community Preservation Act funding, draft financial statements, and an upcoming linkage nexus study. The board also discussed legal ethics constraints on fundraising, draft inclusionary zoning fractional payment language, and action plan implementation priorities.

items.title: Approval of Board and Working Group Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes from January 7, 2026, and the fundraising working group minutes from January 21, 2026.

items.title: Presentation on Racial Disparities in Home Lending
items.summary: Corey Allen and Jennifer Yanko presented Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data highlighting racial disparities in Medford home loan denials and originations, prompting board discussion on down payment assistance and homebuyer education.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Funding Update
items.summary: Staff reported that the City Council approved the trust's funding request for Community Preservation Act funds.

items.title: Financial Reports Presentation
items.summary: Trustee Kayla presented draft financial reports covering fund tracking, balance sheets, and profit-and-loss statements, followed by board discussion on account management and interest allocation.

items.title: Monthly and Quarterly Update Topics
items.summary: The board reviewed suggestions for recurring agenda updates, including financial tracking, zoning changes, condo conversions, and housing development pipelines.

items.title: Fundraising Working Group Update
items.summary: The board discussed potential fundraising avenues and reviewed legal advice regarding conflict-of-interest laws and municipal constraints on soliciting donations.

items.title: Inclusionary Zoning Fractional Payment Ordinance
items.summary: Staff presented updated ordinance language specifying the timeline for developer payment elections and building permit fee calculations.

items.title: Affordable Housing Linkage Nexus Study
items.summary: Staff announced that consultant Carl Seidman was selected to perform the city's affordable housing linkage nexus study.

items.title: Action Plan Implementation and Next Steps
items.summary: The board evaluated action plan goals and agreed to prioritize outreach materials, down payment assistance refinements, and potential equity buy-down programs for low-income homeowners.
